description: CAISO (California) real-time grid fuel mix for today: solar, wind, geothermal, biomass, biogas, small hydro, coal, nuclear, natural gas, large hydro, batteries, imports per 5-minute interval. Returns timestamped MW values per fuel type. Use for "what is California using to make electricity right now", "solar curtailment today", "battery contribution this evening".

limit.description: Latest N intervals to return (default 12 = most-recent hour at 5-min granularity).
